title: Shape-Only Sketch · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Shape-Only Sketch · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write familiar objects on slips. The lead draws a selected object using only circles, triangles and straight lines. Another player guesses the object. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Shape-Only Sketch, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
